South Indian state of [[Tamil Nadu]], was born on 1 July 1950.{{cite web | url=http://www.ias.ac.in/php/fell_detail.php3?name=Balakrishnan&intials=Narayanaswamy&year=01-06-1950 | title=Indian Academy of Sciences | publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015}}{{cite web | url=http://vidwan.inflibnet.ac.in/searchr.php?id=3970 | title=Vidwan | publisher=Vidwan | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015}} He graduated (BE Hons) in Electronics and Communication in 1972 from the [[Coimbatore Institute of Technology]],{{Cite web|title=Distinguished Alumni {{!}} Coimbatore Institute of Technology|url=https://www.cit.edu.in/cit-alumini-association-citaa/distinguished-alumni/|access-date=2021-08-05|website=www.cit.edu.in}} [[University of Madras]] and obtained his doctoral degree (PhD) from the [[Indian Institute of Science]] (IISc), [[Bengaluru]] in 1979.{{Cite web|title=Indian Academy of Sciences, Fellows' Portal|url=https://fellows.ias.ac.in/profile/v/FL1994002}}{{Cite web|title=INDIAN RESEARCH INFORMATION NETWORK SYSTEM|url=http://irins.inflibnet.ac.in/|access-date=2021-08-05|website=irins.inflibnet.ac.in|language=en}}{{Cite web|title=Prof. N. Balakrishnan|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=V6O8IDcAAAAJ&hl=en|access-date=2021-08-05|website=scholar.google.com}}{{Cite web |title=Prof. N. Balakrishnan |url=http://www.serc.iisc.ernet.in/personnel/balki.html |access-date=2021-08-05 |website= |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030605144001fw_/http://www.serc.iisc.ernet.in/personnel/balki.html |archive-date=5 June 2003 |url-status=dead}} He started his career as an assistant professor at the Department of Aerospace Engineering of IISc and continues his service there as an associate director and professor.{{cite web | url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/people/person.asp?personId=83586727&ticker=CBOI:IN&previousCapId=562937&previousTitle=CANARA%2520BANK | title=Bloomberg | publisher=Bloomberg | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015}} He also works as a visiting professor of [[Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research]] and the Institute for Software Research International, [[Carnegie Mellon University]] and is a director of the [[Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management]], [[Industrial Finance Corporation of India]], [[Bharat Sanchar Nigam]] and the [[Data Security Council of India]].{{cite web | url=https://www.zaubacorp.com/director/NARAYANASWAMY-BALAKRISHNAN/00181842 | title=Zauba | publisher=Zauba | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015}} Currently he is heading the National Supercomuting Mission of India approved by Government of India as 7-year project with a budget of 4,500 cr.{{cite web | url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2015-04-06/news/60865957_1_indian-institute-tianhe-2-supercomputing-capabilities | title=ET | date=6 April 2015 | access-date=26 June 2015 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150627043310/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2015-04-06/news/60865957_1_indian-institute-tianhe-2-supercomputing-capabilities# | archive-date=27 June 2015 | url-status=dead | df=dmy-all }} He held the [[Satish Dhawan]] chair professorship of the Division of Information Sciences of [[Indian Institute of Science|IISc]] from 2003 to 2006{{cite web | url=http://www.vala.org.au/vala2006/keyn2006.htm | title=Vala | publisher=Vala | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015 | archive-date=4 March 2015 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150304133918/http://www.vala.org.au/vala2006/keyn2006.htm | url-status=dead }}{{cite web | url=http://www.serc.iisc.ernet.in/~balki/awards.htm | title=Awards | publisher=IISc | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015 | archive-date=9 July 2017 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170709041336/http://www.serc.iisc.ernet.in/~balki/awards.htm | url-status=dead }} and is a former member of the [[National Security Advisory Board]] and the [[Telecom Regulatory Authority of India]]. He is a former Deputy Managing Director of El Forge Ltd, and has held the posts of a director at C-DOT Alcatel Lucent Research Centre{{cite web | url=http://www.carc.co.in/ | title=CARC | publisher=CARC | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150221092256/http://www.carc.co.in/ | archive-date=21 February 2015 }} and [[Bharat Electronics]]. He has also served as a director of the [[Central Bank of India]] from where he retired in January 2015. [[File:Saraju Mohanty with Balki 2013.jpg |thumb|left|Balakrishnan with some of his former students including [[Saraju Mohanty]] and Madhavi Ganapathiraju at the Chicago Alumni Meet in 2013 Hosted by the IISc Alumni Association of North America (IISc AANA).IISc Alumni Association of North America (IISc AANA), https://www.iiscaana.org/]] Balakrishnan is known to have contributed to the establishment of the [[National Centre for Science Information]] and [[Supercomputer Education Research Centre]], in 1984 and 1994 respectively, at the [[Indian Institute of Science]]. He is involved with the ''Million Books to the Web Project (MBP)'', an initiative of the [[Digital Library of India]].{{cite journal | url=http://www.ieee-tcdl.org/Bulletin/v3n1/balakrishnan/balakrishnan.html | title=A Testbed for Indian Language Research | author=N. Balakrishnan | journal=TCDL Bulletin | year=2003 | volume=3 | issue=1}} On the scientific front, his contributions are reported in the areas of monopulse array antennas and [[polarimetric]] [[Radars]]. His scientific achievements and observations have been recorded in over 230 articles published in many peer reviewed national and international journals, [[Google Scholar]], an online repository of scientific articles, listing 216 of them.{{cite web | url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=V6O8IDcAAAAJ&hl=en | title=Google Scholar | publisher=Google Scholar | date=2015 | access-date=25 January 2015}} He was on the Engineering and Computer Science jury for the [[Infosys Prize]] from 2016 to 2018.{{Cite web|last=Infosys Science Foundation|date=30 December 2020|title=Infosys Prize - Jury 2018|url=https://www.infosys-science-foundation.com/prize/jury/jury-2018.asp|access-date=30 December 2020|website=Infosys Science Foundation}} ==Awards and recognitions== Balakrishnan received the [[UNESCO]]/ROSTSCA Young Scientist Award in 1985 followed by the J. C. Bose Memorial Award of the [[Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers]] (IETE) in 1987. Sri Hari Om Prerit Dr. [[Vikram Sarabhai]] Research Award reached him in 1995 and two years later, he received the Platinum Jubilee lecture Award from the [[Indian Science Congress]]. He received two awards in 1998, the [[Institute for the Future]] Award and the [[Aeronautical Society of India]] Aerospace Education Excellence Award. The Indian National Science Congress awarded him the Millennium Medal in 2000 and he received the J. C. Bose Memorial Award for a second time in 2001 followed by the Alumni Award for Excellence from the [[Indian Institute of Science]]. The [[Government of India]] honoured him with the civilian award of [[Padma Shri]] in 2002. The Hari Om Ashram Trust awarded him the Homi J. Bhabha Award in 2004 and [[Coimbatore Institute of Technology]] awarded him the Outstanding Alumnus Medal in 2006. He received the Academy Excellence Award from the [[Defence Research and Development Organization]] in 2009 and Prof. S. N. Mitra Memorial Award from the [[Indian National Academy of Engineering]] in 2013. Balakrishnan, a 2007 J. C. Bose National Fellow of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]], is an elected Fellow of [[Third World Academy of Sciences]], [[Indian National Science Academy]], [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], [[Indian National Academy of Engineering]], [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] and [[Institution of Electronic and Telecommunication Engineers]]. He is a recipient of the doctoral degree of PhD (Honoris Causa) from [[Punjab Technical University]] and has delivered the CDAC-ACS Foundation Award Lecture, Dr. Neelakantan Memorial Award Lecture and Jawaharlal Nehru Centenary Lecture of the [[Indian National Science Academy]]. ==See also== * [[Indian Institute of Science]] * [[Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research]] * [[National Centre for Science Information]] {{portal|India|Science}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.serc.iisc.ernet.in/~balki/ Profile] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180922223210/http://www.serc.iisc.ernet.in/~balki/ |date=22 September 2018 }} at [[Indian Institute of Science]] {{2000s Padma Shri Award Recipients in Science & Engineering}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Balakrishnan, Narayanaswamy}} [[Category:Recipients of the Padma Shri in science & engineering]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Scientists from Tamil Nadu]] [[Category:Indian technology writers]] [[Category:1950 births]] [[Category:Indian Institute of Science alumni]] [[Category:Academic staff of the Indian Institute of Science]] [[Category:Fellows of the Indian Academy of Sciences]] [[Category:Fellows of the Indian National Science Academy]] [[Category:Fellows of the National Academy of Sciences, India]] [[Category:20th-century Indian engineers]]
extract: Narayanaswamy Balakrishnan is an Indian aerospace and computer scientist. He is a Professor of the Department of Aerospace Engineering and Supercomputer Education Research Centre of Indian Institute of Science and a visiting professor of Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research. Balakrishnan was honored by the Government of India, in 2002, with the fourth highest Indian civilian award of Padma Shri
